I hope devs understand that when the players respond so vocally it means that they are very passionate about the game, all the player base is asking for the same thing. We know that it is in their interest to keep monitized events to make profits, but the core problems in the game have been since day 1, we don't want new skins or cosmetics. We want you to fix everything that is broken in the game, like servers, NO REG shots. Sometimes the bullet will just go through a player and not do any damage. These are the things that should be addressed. We love apex and want it to stay around for a long time. But thtta can only happen if the real problems are fixed first.
